subject: Re: Kickoff: fairness evaluation module - M2 status + a scope tension
body:
M2 status on the day.

M1 recap: full repro - simulation_fit_models notebook, run_evaluate.sh with bootstrap CIs, and the selection notebook all reproduce the paper's figures.

M2: Carmen's guardrail heuristics catch 84% of the confounded-gap cases in the simulation's known ground truth at a 7% false-flag rate. Umar's review found one real hole: under selection effects (the paper's third DGP family), the heuristics' catch rate drops to 61% - selection-driven gaps mimic real ones too well for a metric-side heuristic.

The scope tension: fixing the selection case properly means asking customers for data about their selection process, which is a UX and honesty question, not an engineering one. Options: (a) ship guardrails with an explicit "selection effects not covered" disclaimer, (b) add a customer questionnaire that conditions the flags. PMO (Nadia joined the M2 review per Bruno's call - good call) leans (a) for v1.

Amara's sharding is done and dry-run tested, so the July power study is unblocked either way. Decision needed by Jun 12.

Freya
